Message:
serial: 8250_pci: Add support for Pericom PI7C9X795[1248]

Pericom PI7C9X795[1248] are Uno/Dual/Quad/Octal UART devices, this
patch enables them, also defines PCI_VENDOR_ID_PERICOM here.
